description: This file implements the WidevinePlatformDRM class, handling decryption processes via handle conversion to secure memory and invoking a Cdm object for actual decryption. It includes constructor/destructor methods, decryption functions for handle-based decryptions, and references external functions like avbConvertHandleToSecurePointer.

classes.name: WidevinePlatformDRM
classes.description: A class managing Widevine DRM platform operations, specifically handling decryption processes via secure handle conversion and interaction with a Cdm object.

methods.name: WidevinePlatformDRM(widevine::Cdm * cdm)
methods.description: Constructor initializing the Widevine platform DRM object with a reference to a Cdm instance.

methods.name: ~WidevinePlatformDRM()
methods.description: Destructor for cleanup associated with the Widevine platform DRM object.

methods.name: widevine::Cdm::Status decryptWithHandle(int32_t handle,const std::string & session_id,const widevine::Cdm::DecryptionBatch & batch)
methods.description: Decrypts data using a handle and a decryption batch; converts handle to secure memory and invokes the decrypt method on the Cdm object.

methods.name: decryptWithHandle (overload)
methods.description: Decrypts data with a handle, session ID, and decryption batch; performs handle conversion, sets output buffer, and calls Cdm's decrypt with session context.
